messages:
elaine-sales: Quick prep for Wed call with Northbridge Bank. Requirements: EU-only processing, BYOK, proof no cross-border failover during normal ops, and a subprocessor attestation. Need a 90s script + a simple ops handoff.

diego-presales: Short take: Hosted = regional preference only; Dedicated or Private required for hard pin. BYOK supported on Dedicated/Private after KMS onboarding.

raj-eng: Details: Hosted will prefer EU but can route out on capacity/failover. Dedicated = reserve single-region pool (eu-west1 or eu-central1) and disable automatic fallback. Private = customer-managed entirely. BYOK flow: key registration, policy validation, test encrypt/decrypt, and allowlist.

tanya-legal: Current EU subprocessors: LogSafe (audit logs), Observr (metrics), CloudGX (infra). We can provide a DPA, subprocessor list, and SOC2/ISO artifacts. Avoid absolute "never" language for Hosted.

elaine-sales: Can we get two conservative one-liners I can read?

raj-eng: Hosted: "Redwood processes customer workloads primarily in EU regions; in exceptional capacity or recovery events requests may be routed to a compatible region outside the EU; Redwood will notify the customer and propose mitigation."

raj-eng: Dedicated: "Redwood will provision dedicated capacity in the customer-specified EU region and operate with regional pinning; data processing and storage will remain in that region except for control-plane metadata required for platform health and auditing."

ben-pricing: Ballpark numbers for procurement: one-time setup $36k, committed monthly (2x A100 reserved) ~$16.5k, BYOK & attestation add-on ~$4.5k/yr. Final quote depends on throughput and retention.

elaine-sales: Timeline for KMS onboarding and attestation?

lee-ops: KMS onboarding ~2 weeks (key exchange, policy checks, validation). Private/on-prem adds 4-6 weeks. I'll open a handoff ticket with a checklist.

lee-ops: Ops checklist (PROJ-22119): 1) Confirm EU region choice 2) Provide customer KMS key ID + rotation policy 3) Subprocessor attestation deliverable 4) IP allowlist & egress certs 5) Audit log retention requirements 6) SLA/penalty items + runbook.

raj-eng: Example routing policy (Dedicated pin):

```
{"routing":"pin","region":"eu-west1","fallback":"none"}
```

elaine-sales: Perfect. I'll use the lines, mention pricing and timeline, and promise PROJ-22119 follow-up with attestation + formal quote.

ticket-bot: Ticket PROJ-22119 created and assigned to @lee-ops.

elaine-sales: Thanks team ":thumbsup:" — I'll post customer notes and any redlines after the call.
